context: After class. Hina has stayed behind to show Ms. Asuka a picture she drew during break.
purpose: teacher-student bond — attentive recognition of a child's small offering

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 先生、見て見て！描いたの！
lines.en: Teacher, look look! I drew it!
lines.style: Bright urgent child voice, the second 「見て」 even brighter, a small jumping energy in delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: わあ、すごく綺麗な色だね。
lines.style: Patient teacher warmth, kneeling-down register in the voice, real attention given to the small artwork.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: High child certainty, total conviction on the favorite, bright pitched declaration delivered fully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: お花、上手に描けてるよ。
lines.en: You drew the flowers really well.
lines.style: Teacher specific praise, naming what is good carefully, encouragement that recognizes the actual effort.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: えへへ、おかあさんにあげる！
lines.en: Heehee, I'm giving it to Mom!
lines.style: Pleased child giggling chirp, the gift-plan already lifting the voice into anticipated joy ahead.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: きっと喜んでくれるよ。気をつけて帰ってね。
lines.en: She'll surely be happy. Get home safely now.
lines.style: Warm teacher closing, gentle send-off softness, the care behind the routine instruction palpable in tone.
